custom_logic_notes: EA uses previous bar values ([1] and [2]) for crossover detection, not current bar. This prevents repainting but also means signals lag by one bar. No position check means EA can open unlimited positions on repeated crossover signals every tick until crossover condition expires.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward dual-EMA crossover. Key details: (1) Crossover uses bar index [1] and [2] (previous and two bars ago), not [0]. (2) SL/TP are in pips with 5-digit broker adjustment (multiply by 10 when digits==5). (3) No position check — EA stacks positions on every tick while crossover is active. Python version should consider adding a new-bar guard or position check to prevent position stacking. (4) Slow EMA period is derived as Periods+2. (5) Filling type FOK maps to entire order must fill or cancel.
